description: This file defines a custom report class for auction totals in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods to generate XML report data based on auction lot information.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for creating auction total reports in XML format.

methods.name: toxml
methods.description: Converts a string to XML-safe format by replacing special characters and encoding.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report string with auction data, including object counts, estimates, buyer and seller info.
